cases.goal: Repair integer addition that subtracts its operands
cases.initial_source:
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a - b
cases.proposed_source:
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b
cases.expected_source:
def add(a: int, b: int) -> int:
    return a + b

cases.goal: Repair normalization that leaves surrounding whitespace
cases.initial_source:
def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    return text.lower()
cases.proposed_source:
def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    return text.strip().lower()
cases.expected_source:
def normalize(text: str) -> str:
    return text.strip().lower()

cases.goal: Repair clamp so it enforces the upper bound
cases.initial_source:
def clamp(value: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
    return max(value, low)
cases.proposed_source:
def clamp(value: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
    return min(max(value, low), high)
cases.expected_source:
def clamp(value: int, low: int, high: int) -> int:
    return min(max(value, low), high)

cases.goal: Repair title casing but propose an incorrect uppercase change
cases.initial_source:
def title(text: str) -> str:
    return text.lower()
cases.proposed_source:
def title(text: str) -> str:
    return text.upper()
cases.expected_source:
def title(text: str) -> str:
    return text.title()
